import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

employees = ["Ana", "Bruno", "Carla", "Diego", "Elena", "Fabio"]
shifts = ["M1", "M2", "P1", "P2", "N1", "N2"]
costs = {
    ("Ana", "M1"): 8,
    ("Ana", "M2"): 7,
    ("Ana", "P1"): 9,
    ("Ana", "P2"): 8,
    ("Bruno", "M1"): 7,
    ("Bruno", "M2"): 8,
    ("Bruno", "P1"): 8,
    ("Bruno", "P2"): 9,
    ("Carla", "M2"): 9,
    ("Carla", "P1"): 8,
    ("Carla", "P2"): 8,
    ("Carla", "N1"): 11,
    ("Carla", "N2"): 12,
    ("Diego", "M1"): 10,
    ("Diego", "P1"): 9,
    ("Diego", "P2"): 8,
    ("Diego", "N1"): 10,
    ("Diego", "N2"): 11,
    ("Elena", "M1"): 8,
    ("Elena", "M2"): 10,
    ("Elena", "P1"): 9,
    ("Elena", "P2"): 9,
    ("Elena", "N1"): 12,
    ("Elena", "N2"): 10,
    ("Fabio", "M1"): 9,
    ("Fabio", "M2"): 8,
    ("Fabio", "P1"): 10,
    ("Fabio", "P2"): 7,
}
night_shifts = {"N1", "N2"}

model = gp.Model("M03_turni")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = {}
for i in employees:
    for j in shifts:
        if (i, j) in costs:
            x[i, j] = model.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"x_{i}_{j}")

model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(costs[i, j] * x[i, j] for (i, j) in x), GRB.MINIMIZE)

for j in shifts:
    model.addConstr(
        gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in employees if (i, j) in x) == 1,
        name=f"shift_{j}"
    )

for i in employees:
    model.addConstr(
        gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in shifts if (i, j) in x) <= 2,
        name=f"max_turni_{i}"
    )

for i in employees:
    night_vars = [j for j in night_shifts if (i, j) in x]
    if night_vars:
        model.addConstr(
            gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in night_vars) <= 1,
            name=f"max_notturni_{i}"
        )

start_solution = {
    ("Ana", "M2"): 1,
    ("Bruno", "M1"): 1,
    ("Carla", "P1"): 1,
    ("Diego", "N1"): 1,
    ("Elena", "N2"): 1,
    ("Fabio", "P2"): 1,
}
for key, val in start_solution.items():
    if key in x:
        x[key].Start = val

model.optimize()

status_map = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.CUTOFF: "CUTOFF",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.SOLUTION_LIMIT: "SOLUTION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
    GRB.INPROGRESS: "INPROGRESS",
    GRB.LOADED: "LOADED",
}
status_str = status_map.get(model.Status, f"STATUS_{model.Status}")

if model.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    solution_json = {
        "status": status_str,
        "objective": model.ObjVal,
        "variables": {v.VarName: v.X for v in model.getVars()},
    }
else:
    solution_json = {"status": status_str, "objective": None, "variables": {}}

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution_json))
```
